summary: Iteration 90 - Platform Branding & White-Label Testing Complete. All 14 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI testing verified all branding features: Settings page Platform Branding tab with Company Identity, Logo uploads, Brand Colors, Login Page Customization, Invoice/Email Branding. Sidebar and Login page correctly display branded company name (STech Solutions). Recurring invoice Add Line button works in both Create and Edit dialogs.
seed_data_creation: Test branding data created and restored during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 90 tested Platform Branding white-label features. Key endpoints: GET /api/settings/branding (auth required), GET /api/settings/branding/public (no auth - for login/sidebar), PUT /api/settings/branding (update all branding), POST /api/settings/branding/upload-logo?logo_type=company|icon|invoice (multipart upload). Settings page has 7 tabs with Platform Branding as first tab. Current branding: company_name='STech Solutions', login_tagline='Your trusted IT partner'. Sidebar fetches branding via /api/settings/branding/public on mount. Login page also uses public endpoint. Recurring invoice Add Line button works in both Create (/recurring-invoices/create) and Edit dialogs.
